Product Details: Restore your vehicle's shine with JOPASU One Step Polish Wax (120ml), an all-in-one solution designed to clean, polish, and protect your car's painted surfaces. Its advanced formula helps remove light scratches, swirl marks, oxidation, and dullness while enhancing the paint with a deep, glossy finish. JOPASU One Step Polish Wax forms a protective layer that helps preserve your vehicle's paint from everyday environmental elements, keeping it looking cleaner and shinier for longer. The easy-to-apply formula delivers professional-quality results with minimal effort, making it ideal for regular vehicle maintenance. Key Features Cleans, polishes, and protects in one easy step Restores paint shine with a rich, high-gloss finish Helps reduce the appearance of light scratches, swirl marks, and oxidation Leaves a smooth, polished surface with long-lasting protection Easy-to-use formula for quick and effortless application Suitable for all paint finishes on cars and bikes Ideal for regular detailing and paint maintenance Directions for Use Wash and dry the vehicle thoroughly. Shake the bottle well before use. Apply a small amount of polish wax to a clean microfiber cloth or applicator pad. Spread evenly using circular motions. Allow it to haze slightly, then buff with a clean, dry microfiber cloth to reveal a deep, glossy shine.
